requirement: Listing photos are uploaded without location metadata
expected: A phone JPEG with GPS EXIF is stored re-encoded, at most 2,400 px on its longest side, with no EXIF block.
preconditions: Particular seller with a complete profile; a JPEG over 5 MB with GPS data.
steps: Publish a listing with the photo; inspect the stored object in listing-photos.

requirement: Big phone photos are accepted on create and edit
expected: Photos up to 40 MB are accepted and shrunk; no 5 MB refusal appears.
steps: Add a 10 MB photo on Publicar and on Editar.

requirement: After publishing a SKU the next listing does not reuse it
expected: Publicar otro instrumento opens an empty publish page with no SKU; Volver al SKU and Publicar el siguiente SKU sin publicación work.
preconditions: Store with inventory and two unlinked SKUs.
steps: Publish a SKU; use each confirmation action.

requirement: Photos come first and upload while the seller fills in the rest
expected: Step 1 is Fotos on phones and computers; each photo shows upload progress and is uploaded before Publicar is pressed.
steps: Add three photos, continue to step 2 at once, watch the photos finish uploading.

requirement: A listing in progress is never lost
expected: Closing and reopening Publicar offers the saved form with its photos; Descartar clears it.
steps: Fill steps 1 and 2, close the tab, reopen Publicar.

requirement: A saved draft opens on another device
expected: Guardar borrador lists the draft in Mis publicaciones; Continuar on another browser opens it with its photos; publishing removes it.
steps: Save a draft in one browser, continue and publish it in the other.

requirement: Drafts are private and limited
expected: Another user cannot read, change or delete a draft; a 21st draft is refused; a published submission cannot become a draft.
steps: Run tests/ux-effortless-selling.sql.

requirement: iPhone HEIC photos are accepted
expected: A HEIC photo is converted and stored as JPEG.
preconditions: Particular seller with a HEIC photo.
steps: Add the HEIC photo on Publicar.

requirement: Photos can be rearranged without dragging
expected: Anterior, Siguiente and Usar como principal reorder photos; the first photo is labelled Principal.
steps: Use each button on a photo.

requirement: The shot list follows the category
expected: Choosing Guitarras shows the guitar shots; a shot taken is marked as done.
steps: Pick a category; tap Frente and add a photo.

requirement: The title writes itself until edited
expected: Brand and model fill the title; once the seller edits the title it no longer changes.
steps: Type brand and model, then edit the title and change the model.

requirement: Brand suggestions come from the catalog
expected: The brand field suggests the catalog's brands for the chosen category.
steps: Pick Guitarras and focus Marca.

requirement: Description starters and counter
expected: A starter is inserted on its own line with the caret after it; the counter shows a check at 40 characters.
steps: Tap a starter and type.

requirement: The seller sees the card and the page before sending
expected: Step 4 shows the catalog card and, on request, the listing page with the seller block and trust text.
steps: Open step 4 and Ver cómo se verá la página.

requirement: Hints warn without blocking
expected: A phone number, link, all-caps title or price under S/ 20 shows a hint; Publicar still works.
steps: Type a phone number in the description and publish.

requirement: Publish a similar one
expected: Publicar uno parecido keeps category, brand, condition, location and description but not photos, price, model or title. Duplicar is EASE-423 (docs/ux-effortless/integration.md, UXD-integration-2).
steps: Press Publicar uno parecido.

requirement: The review wait is shown only from real data
expected: With fewer than 20 reviewed Particular listings in 60 days no wait is shown; with more, the median is.
steps: Run tests/ux-effortless-selling.sql; send a listing for review.

requirement: A live listing is celebrated and easy to share
expected: A direct publication shows Tu publicación está en línea, Ver publicación and Compartir; the approval e-mail opens the listing.
steps: Publish as a verified store; render the approval e-mail.

requirement: Sound clips are short, optional and never autoplay
expected: Clips stop at 20 seconds; the listing and the Admin queue load the clip only on tap; a pending listing's clip is hidden from the public.
steps: Record a clip, publish, open the Admin queue and the approved listing.

requirement: Store defaults prefill new listings
expected: Valores por defecto sets the condition and the standard text; new store listings start with both; the minimum counts only the seller's own words.
steps: Save defaults, open Publicar, try continuing with only the standard text.

requirement: A SKU remembers its listing details
expected: After publishing a SKU, or editing Datos para publicar, Publicar este SKU starts with its brand, model, condition and description.
steps: Publish a SKU, unlink it, publish it again.
